fields.System.Title: RET-403 — Send to repair
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want repairable returns moved to a repair area, so that
they are tracked while out of sellable stock rather than disappearing.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a repairable grade, then the stock moves to a repair location and stays out of
  • availability.
  • - Given stock in repair, then it is visible, countable, and ageing-reportable.
  • - Given a completed repair, then the stock re-enters inspection before it can be
  • restocked.
  • - Given an unsuccessful repair, then the stock can be scrapped through
  • [RET-405](RET-405-scrap-with-approval.md).
  • - Given stock in repair beyond a configured age, then it is escalated.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory |
| Tables | disposition, stock_balance |
| Risks | Stock parked in repair indefinitely and forgotten |
| Tests | unit · integration |
